QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Shindig Shakeup
QuestInfo.0: Crash the party at the Aspire VIP Area with the pass you purchased from #bAlec#k.\r\nIf Phoebe's algorithm is right, a Wondroid there might soon need help.
